Claude Code Token Usage Reducer

TokenTrim is a free, local toolkit that helps extend Claude Code usage limits by optimizing tool output and file reading. It can make your Claude Code limits last roughly 4x longer, with a dashboard to track token spend per session.

What you get

Free version available, Pro for $49 lifetime, Pro for $9/month

Why tokentrim

TokenTrim is designed for developers and CTOs at 10-200 person US software companies who hit Claude Code limits, helping them get the most out of their resources. By using TokenTrim, you can reduce the likelihood of hitting these limits and make your Claude Code usage more efficient.

FAQ

Is TokenTrim affiliated with Anthropic? No, TokenTrim is not affiliated with Anthropic.

What are the benefits of using TokenTrim Pro? TokenTrim Pro adds a live dashboard on any device, a Monday report and budget alerts, for $49 lifetime or $9 per month.
